nuggetLighthouse.title: File:Lighthouse Nugget Point Otago. (52225852796).jpg
nuggetLighthouse.author: Bernard Spragg. NZ from Christchurch, New Zealand
nuggetLighthouse.description:
The 10-metre Nugget Point lighthouse stands 76 metres above sea level on a point close to the ‘nugget’ rocks. First lit in 1870, the lighthouse was automated in 1988.
This is a beautiful coastal stroll to one of the oldest lighthouses in New Zealand.
Nugget Point Lighthouse provides stunning views of the coast, rocks, and the ocean. Bring a camera or some binoculars so you can see all birds and seals below the lighthouse. Keep your eyes open for rare penguins and dolphins in the water.

Going early in the morning or catching the sunset is highly recommended!
